archetype: Electric & Neon (Future, Speed, Disruption) - Futuristic AI-HUD Inspired

typography.headings: Orbitron, Rajdhani, or Space Mono (Tech/HUD vibe)
typography.monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, or Source Code Pro (For HUD data and logs)
rules: Use tight letter spacing for HUD metrics.
Use uppercase with wide tracking (e.g., tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines, system status, and labels.
Avoid standard sans-serif for primary HUD titles; use monospace or technical sans.
Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000). Always tint with navy/blue.
Gradients should be used for glowing effects and light bleeds, not flat backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] on key icons, active state text, and HUD readouts.
visual_enhancers.hud_elements: Add technical grid overlays, corner brackets (border-t-2 border-l-2), crosshairs, and subtle scanlines to panels.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use extremely subtle noise overlay to give the deep space background a physical, cinematic texture.

layout.structure: Full-screen absolute/fixed layout (100vh). No global scrolling. Content scrolls within specific glass panels.
layout.center: Large 3D Holographic Sphere rendering using React Three Fiber. Absolute centered (z-0), forming the core of the UI.
layout.corners: HUD Overlays fixed to corners (z-10). Top-Left: System Status & Language, Top-Right: Time/Date & Weather, Bottom: Voice Controls & Text Input.
layout.sidebars: Collapsible glassmorphism panels on left/right for Chat History, Notes, and Reminders (z-20).

components.HolographicSphere: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei. Render a <Sphere> with wireframe or an emissive standard material. Animate rotation and scale using useFrame hook based on idle/listening/speaking states.
components.VoiceVisualizer: Create an audio waveform visualization at the bottom when listening/speaking. Use an array of vertical bars animated with framer-motion reacting to an audio mock state.
components.TypewriterText: For AI chat responses, use a typewriter effect (e.g., revealing text character by character) paired with a monospace font to feel like system output.
components.HUDIndicators: Use absolute positioning. Add technical micro-copy like 'SYS.ONLINE', 'LAT.12ms', 'MEM.42%' scattered around to build the futuristic AI-HUD feel.
components.GlassPanel: Reusable wrapper for Notes, Chat, and Reminders using the glassmorphism rules. Must have sharp or slightly rounded corners (max rounded-md).

motion.transitions: Smooth, futuristic transitions. Use framer-motion for panel sliding (x-axis translations) and opacity fading.

sphere_states.idle: Slow, smooth continuous rotation. Subtle cyan glow.
sphere_states.listening: Pulsating scale (1 to 1.1) with increased emissive glow. Color shift to bright cyan.
sphere_states.thinking: Erratic wireframe rotation, deep blue/magenta hue shifts.
sphere_states.speaking: Rapid waveform-like fluctuations in scale. Intense cyan glow.

accessibility: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text over glass panels. Use text-shadow if necessary.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, panel triggers).
instructions_to_main_agent: Setup a dark space theme by updating tailwind.config.js with the provided colors and extending the font families.
Import Google Fonts: 'Orbitron' and 'JetBrains Mono' (or similar monospace/tech fonts) via index.css.
Implement the layout with a central 3D scene (React Three Fiber) occupying the full background using absolute positioning.
Create HUD overlays with absolute positioning in the four corners.
Implement the Sidebar for Notes/Reminders using Framer Motion for slide-in/out animations.
The central sphere MUST respond to the AI states (Idle, Listening, Thinking, Speaking) using props that drive Three.js animations.
Add a typewriter effect for AI chat messages to match the futuristic AI-HUD aesthetic.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn default styling. Heavily customize components with the glassmorphism, 1px cyan borders, and glowing text.
Implement a Language Toggle (TR/EN) in the HUD.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use technical icons from lucide-react.
Always use modern futuristic button styles (sharp corners or lightly rounded with neon glow on hover and 1px inner borders).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
